The portal shows the English title as "Register of issued taxi passenger authorisations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Таня Павлова. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-bulgaria.
